name: Kurukuru Summer 2019

venue.name: [池上会館(Ikegami Hall)](https://www.city.ota.tokyo.jp/shisetsu/ikegamikaikan/index.html)
venue.address: 〒146-0082 東京都大田区池上一丁目32番8号(Ota CityIkegami1-chome number 32 of zip 146-0082 Number 8)

information: 本大会は勝者を決めるのを第一の目的としない記録会です。 午前中にキューバー同士が交流できる時間を設けています。 初めての参加者にも競技内容レクチャーを行いますので是非ご参加ください。 This competition is organized not only to detemine a winner but also to encourage beginners to participate in a competition. Cuber's meetup will be held in the morning of the competition day. During this meetup, beginners who participate in cube competition for the first time may learn how to compete in a competition.
